reason: Only evidence is an OSHA complaint inspection (Apr 2018, 5 employees, NAICS 321992) for Innovative Panel Solutions at 6778 Bld D E. Traverse Hwy. No company site, registry or current listing found; 6778 E Traverse Hwy now shows as a 12,000 sq ft property with other occupants (e.g. Rare Earth Hardwoods). Cannot confirm current operation or product (row's Wood Volumetric Modular is unsupported).

Fabricated Wood Products Inc (MN corp 1N-1166, listed Active) is a truss maker at 6150 W Frontage Rd, Medford (BBB, Sweets). But the 77,676 SF 1982 building there is listed for sale ($1.6M, multi-tenant) and no current production evidence found, so operating status is unconfirmed. City should be Medford, not Clinton Falls Township; capability is trusses, not volumetric modular.

American Truss Company, L.L.C. (FL L03000031159, 5605 Commercial Blvd) is listed Inactive with the Florida Dept of State; owner's LinkedIn shows the company ran Sep 2003 - Jun 2010; Superpages tags the listing CLOSED; the 5605 Commercial Blvd parcel sold in 2020 and is now marketed as a warehouse / truck-parking yard for lease.

No Avon Modular page or registry places an Avon plant at 3023 Porter Road, Lithia; Avon's registry/DBPR address is its Lakeland office (1074 S Florida Ave). 3023 Porter Road is the registered address of Custom Modular Manufacturing, LLC (FL L18000237289) and M-N-M Construction, Inc., i.e. the same site as IC-92733 'Custom Modular Manufacturing'. Likely Avon's 'Plant 2' is CMM's Lithia plant and this row duplicates IC-92733, but no source states the link - owner to decide merge.

Builder Modules LLC (FL M24000005440, est. 2024) is registered at 200 Willard St, Cocoa - the ModPod address (IC-94928); it owns the MODPOD trademark. Home Nation markets Builder Modules as factory-built. The row's phone 574-202-7070 is Home Nation Indiana (a retailer). 837 N Cocoa Blvd is a multi-tenant gated industrial building listed for lease (tenants incl. a yacht refinisher); no source places a Builder Modules plant there. Possibly a second ModPod/Builder Modules shop or a duplicate of IC-94928 - unconfirmed.

ICG (Builders FirstSource) lists Green Cove Springs, 4750 J P Hall Blvd as one of its 'ICG MANUFACTURING LOCATIONS'; the plant makes trusses and wall panels for off-site framing. Record website greencovesprings.com is the city's site and should be icgbuilds.com.

V10 Construction at 13301 Louvre St, Pacoima is a design-build general contractor (residential/commercial construction and project management); CSLB license types General Building, Glazing, General Engineering. No truss, panel or modular manufacturing described.

Relocated: North Georgia Truss (same phone 770-387-4227) now operates from its new facility at 110 Keith Road NE, Cartersville GA 30121 (IC-95221, building constructed 2018); 1279 Joe Frank Harris Pkwy SE survives only in older directory listings.

Southeastern Truss, Inc. at 45 Industrial Blvd, Camilla GA is classified as a wooden roof truss manufacturer (SIC 'Trusses, Wooden Roof', ~19 employees, operating ~43 years) and listed under Roof Trusses; the earlier 'roofing' reading came from generic directory categories. No company site found.

Specialty Structural Products at 1518 Industrial Dr, Griffin GA 30224 makes trusses/engineered structural wood components (YP: Roof Trusses, Trusses-Construction; 40 yrs). Its domain specialtystructural.com now redirects to Griffin Lumber & Hardware, which reports operating two truss manufacturing facilities - SSP appears to be GL&H's Griffin truss plant (the 1111 Memorial Dr address is GL&H's retail store, not this plant).

Roanoke Truss is listed as a truss manufacturer at 711 E 15th St, Roanoke Rapids (Chamber of Commerce, MapQuest); Roanoke Rapids Graded School District thanked Roanoke Truss Co. for hosting construction students at the plant. The earlier 'Closed' reading was a store-hours 'CLOSED NOW' tag, not a closure.

North Georgia Truss (independent family-owned truss manufacturer, not 84 Lumber) operates its truss plant at 110 Keith Road NE, Cartersville GA 30121 (chamber listing, 'Manufacturers'); its site describes engineered wood roof/floor truss manufacturing in a new Georgia facility. Website should be ngtruss.com, not 84lumber.com.

Seminole Trusses' own site gives 30726 Blue Star Highway, Midway FL 32343 and describes wood roof and floor truss production; directories cite a 60,000+ sq ft facility in Midway. Candidate duplicate IC-96688 named earlier no longer exists in golden; no other row found.

Same plant as IC-13325 (WORLD INTERNATIONAL TRUSS INC., 15411 Rattlesnake Gulch Rd, Oro Grande CA 92368, same phone 760-895-5329). OSHA lists the site address 15411 Rattlesnake Gulch Rd, Oro Grande; this row lacks the city.

574 Longleaf Drive, Richmond Hill is a residential lot/single-family home built in 2022; the OSHA record is a job-site inspection of ICG (a framing/truss company mailing from Jacksonville FL), not a plant location.
5216 Shad Road, Jacksonville is ICG's office ('Office - 904-398-5690 5216 Shad Road'); its manufacturing locations are 4750 J P Hall Blvd, Green Cove Springs (IC-94333) and Florence SC.

US Components, LLC is a separate truss plant from L&L Manufactured Components; its YP listing describes a wood truss fabrication plant at 3131 S Country Club Rd, Tucson 85713 (SBCA-accredited, 30 yrs). Company site us-components.com timed out on retrieval.

Gleckler and Sons (core products include manufactured floor and roof trusses) lists 3615 S US-1, Bunnell as one of its locations; the parcel is owned by Gleckler LLC and the same address is the long-standing Truss Systems LLC truss plant (directory category truss manufacturer). Separate site from Gleckler's Jacksonville plant (IC-21873), so not a duplicate.

Martin Metal LLC's only plant is at 18151 Highway K, Versailles MO (company site, MapQuest: 'built to order trusses'), already row IC-96566. 6587 Saint Moritz Dr, Osage Beach is a 2,522 sq ft single-family home (Zillow).

2625 Durahart St was a Builders FirstSource truss site ('Riverside Ca Truss', NAICS 321214) now listed as 'Builders FirstSource - CLOSED' at that address in two directories; OSHA's Oct 2025 inspection there recorded scope 'No Insp/Process Inactive', and the 7.26-acre parcel is marketed as vacant industrial land. BFS's active Inland Empire truss plant is Perris CA Truss.

OSHA establishment record for Elko Truss Inc at 1047 Panorama Dr, Elko (NAICS 321214 Truss Manufacturing) is coded 'No Insp/Out of Business'. Elko Truss now operates from 1225 Silver State Dr, Spring Creek NV 89815 (FMCSA carrier record, Chamber listing) - relocation. Row website elko-search.gsacorp.io is not the company's.

Advanced Precut Systems (assumed name of Bludorn Builders LLC) builds precut framing packages and pre-built wall panels in its own climate-controlled facility; SBCA component-manufacturer map lists it at 710 Pacific Avenue W, Dassel (principal office is 215 Atlantic Ave W, Dassel).

Beau-Trusses (owned by Structures Ultratec) lists its plant at 67 Jarado Way, Boscawen (company contact page, NH registry), not 112 High St Bldg #7. That building collapsed in an electrical fire on 12/26/2024; the plant manager said they hoped to rebuild within a year and the company site still shows business hours, but I found no confirmation of rebuilt/resumed production, so operating status is unresolved (not closed).

Bequall is a modular-development consultancy that coordinates third-party factories (feasibility, factory matching, factory contracting support); it does not operate a plant. 1642 Pinot Place, Brentwood is a residential street address, not a factory.

Big C Lumber's own locations page lists its Structural Building Components Facility (floor trusses, wall panels, roof trusses) in Dowagiac, Michigan; map listing places 'Big C Lumber -Truss & Panel' at 30600 Edwards St, Dowagiac.

1082 Mountain View St, Hendersonville is a 2,129 sq ft single-family home (Zillow). Blue Ridge Building Components Inc operates at 208 Justice Hills Dr, Dana NC (Chamber of Commerce, MapQuest; Henderson County Chamber lists 220 Justice Hills Dr), which is row IC-66591.
Builders Choice's own contact page lists its 'Truss Fabrication Facility' at 500 South Sylvan Road, Wasilla, AK 99654 (separate from the 4201 E Palmer-Wasilla Hwy retail store).

Builders FirstSource's Kalispell component plant ('Kalispell MT Panel', facility type Trusses, Wall Panels and Components) is at 140 Industrial Court = row IC-64869 (BMC WEST, 140 Industry Ct). The W Reserve Dr cluster is BFS's lumber yard (41 W Reserve Dr) and millwork (35 W Reserve Dr); 21 W Reserve Dr is a 5,838 sq ft warehouse with no plant listed.

This row (1803 7th St SW, phone 863-294-0611) is the American Builders Supply 'Winter Haven Truss' plant at 1801 7th Street S.W., Winter Haven 33880, phone (863) 294-0611 - already IC-95208. It is not Carpenter Contractors of America, whose Winter Haven plant is 3900 Ave G NW (IC-22512).

Map listing and business profile both place Center Truss Co, a truss/structural wood members maker, at 23296 Corner Rd, Centreville MI (phone 269-467-7421). D&B lists an older address at 58871 Walterspaugh Rd; Corner Rd is the current listed location. No duplicate row found.

Dwell Alabama is listed by SBCA as a Component Manufacturer member (since 2025) with phone 256-426-3740, but that phone and 1214 Meridian St belong to Butler Builders (J.R. Butler Inc.), a Huntsville custom home builder office; 1214 Meridian St N is also a retail shop (Preservation Co). No plant address for Dwell Alabama found.

ENN Enterprises (NE LLC filed 2019, Active, mailing address 86372 512 Avenue, Orchard) is on SBCA's component-manufacturer member map at 86372 512th Avenue, Orchard. Small rural shop; no website found, so confidence modest.

Highmark Truss and Lumber, LLC (FL L22000315939) does business as Taunton Truss, a truss manufacturer whose plant is at 5441 FL-71 (S Highway 71), Wewahitchka FL 32465. The row's Chamblee GA address (4983 New Peachtree Rd Suite A) is Buckhaven Construction Services' office, unrelated to the plant. Record should move to Wewahitchka, FL.

SBCA component-manufacturer map lists 'Junker Forest Products' at 5849 County Road 77, Littlefork, but Junker Forest Products LLC is registered in Duluth, and Junkers' own site describes only a lumber yard/remodeling showroom reopened in 2022 (no truss plant). Its Facebook mentions 'Trusses ready for delivery' but that may be resale. Plant not confirmed; removal not supported by two sources.

L&P Building Supply's own truss page: 'L&P Building Supply and Components provides quality roof and floor truss systems... if you can dream it, more than likely, we can build it' - a truss operation within the lumber yard at 101 N. Archuleta, Las Cruces; also an SBCA component-manufacturer member at 101 N Archuleta Rd. (Valle Del Sol Components, IC-70449, 101 N Walnut, appears to be a separate company.)

Mid-MO Truss's own site: truss manufacturer (roof and floor trusses since 1972) at 103 Progress Pkwy, Cuba MO 65453. SBCA lists it as Mid-Missouri Truss Inc at '103 Progressive Dr' (same place); no other Cuba row in golden.

Midwest Lumber (legal name Midwest Millwork & Truss LLC, Urich MO) is hiring for truss production in Urich (LinkedIn) and runs a TPI-certified truss plant per its site. Address unresolved: row/SBCA say 298 E Graham Rd, while MapQuest, FMCSA and SoS use 205 E Graham Rd.

Bluebook ProView lists R & R Truss Mill (Wood Roof Trusses) at 30444 Highway 84, Malvern AR 72104 as main location. The earlier 'closed' reading came from directory 'Closed now' opening-hours text, not a closure. Note: record website vermontbridges.com is an unrelated Vermont covered-bridge site and should be dropped.

No source ties 'Ridge Top Truss' to the Big Lake PO box or to phone 360-903-2383. A similarly named RidgeTop Truss (Ridgetop Truss LLC, AK entity 10269924) builds trusses 'in our shop based out of Wasilla' (Facebook, phone 907-521-0437); its registry principal address is 9778 W Rosehill Cir, Wasilla 99623, but no source confirms that as the shop location. Likely the same business; plant street address unconfirmed.

Sage Building Components is a dba of Straight Up Framing LC, whose own site lists only 56772 241st St, Ames and describes fabricating all framing components in its manufacturing facility (BIM + off-site prefabrication) before delivery to site.

Sandhill Truss LLC (MN, filed 2021, Active) has its registered address at 26180 443rd St SE, Winger, matching the SBCA component-manufacturer listing 'Sand Hill Truss (Co)' at 26180 443 Street SE. NOTE: the row's website sandhillcarbs.com and phone 218-902-0179 belong to an unrelated carburetor shop (Sand Hill Carbs & Floats, 42475 260th Ave SE) and should be cleared.

Show ME Truss, LLC (MO LLC filed Jan 2024, Active; principal office and agent Lester W. Troyer at 2839 Audrain Road 132, Clark) is listed on SBCA's component-manufacturer member map at the same address; a small rural truss shop on the owner's property.
St. Rosa Lumber's own page: wall panel fabrication facility added 2024 and truss manufacturing 2025, at 29033 Co Rd 17, Freeport MN 56331.

Summit Truss (builds trusses) operates at 7774 Brickyard Rd, Holton MI per Chamber of Commerce and MapQuest listings; the row's 8892 Maple Island Rd is a 1,554 sq ft ranch home (Redfin) and the LLC's registered-agent address. Row phone 201-821-0003 looks like a typo of 231-821-0003.

'Twin Oaks Truss' is a Missouri assumed name (filed Nov 2022, Active) with mailing address 31058 Twin Oaks Ln, Kirksville, and SBCA's component-manufacturer map lists Twin Oaks Truss at that address. Unrelated to Twin Oaks Custom Cabinets (Neosho) flagged earlier. Small rural shop; confidence modest.
WB Components LLC's own contact page: truss plant ('our automated tables and our high-tech saws') at 8826 76th Street SE, Edgeley ND 58433 (row has 8827).
2151 59th St, St. Louis is occupied by Animal House Cat Rescue and Adoption Center (assumed name filed May 2025 at that address); no evidence any modular plant operates there.

Pivot Structures builds container-based backyard studios/ADUs/bunkhouses ('LIVE UNCONTAINED'; listed as a Colorado container home builder) - a shipping-container conversion shop under the owner's scope ruling, not an IC plant.

MLS listing for 655 Cal Oak Rd describes Endeavor Homes as a manufacturer of packaged wood structures with an 11k SF truss line with truss manufacturing equipment and a wall line with wall manufacturing equipment. Property/business sold ~2024; current operator unknown and company domain lapsed.

84 Lumber's own Components Manufacturing page lists only the Dunn Truss Plant (Store #2383, 200 Emmett Road = row IC-94264) in Dunn; no Dunn panel plant (#2385) is listed. 603 N Ashe Ave is a 20,000 SF 1970 warehouse marketed for lease, with Quinn Speciality Products listed at 603 N Ashe Ave B.
